units.text: Say your app needs to store a logo and read it back. It sends a put request to store the object and a get request to fetch it. S three checks the caller's access before returning the bytes. An object encrypted with a customer-managed K M S key also needs the relevant key permission.

In this Region, the bucket is app-data and the full key is images slash logo dot png. The slash can help organize a listing, but it does not create a file-system directory. The object has its own bytes and metadata, such as the content type, and uses a storage class.

Enable versioning if you need earlier copies, and use lifecycle rules to transition or expire eligible objects. Choose S three when the app works with complete objects through an A P I. If it needs shared file-system access or in-place block writes, choose a different storage model.
